title: Finitely generated algebras over Noetherian rings are Noetherian
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $R\to S$ a ring map of commutative rings of finite type, i.e. $S\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/\mathfrak a$ as $R$-algebras for some $n\ge0$ and some ideal $\mathfrak a$. Then $S$ is a Noetherian ring.
